title: Running Commentary on Torah 55 — Abba Shaul Kover Meisim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 55 — אבא שאול קובר מתים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Niddah 24b**: **"Abba Shaul omer: kover meisim hayisi. Pa'am achas ratzti achar tzvi v'nichnasti b'kulis shel meis..."** 'I was a burier of the dead. Once I chased a tzvi (deer/gazelle) and entered into the **kulis** (femur/leg-bone) of a corpse...'

intermediate.en: **Nid 24b**: Abba Shaul chased **tzvi** into the **kulis** of a meis.
intermediate.he: **נדה כד:**: אבא שאול רץ אחר **צבי** לתוך **קוליתו של מת**.

beginner.en: **"α. To see the **downfall of resha'im** is possible only via **bechina of EY**. **'Sheiv li'mini ad ashis oyvecha hadom l'raglecha'** (Tehillim 110:1; Zohar Lech Lecha 86b). **Yamin=EY=Binyamin** (ben-yamin, born in EY; see Rashi Vayishlach)."**

intermediate.en: **α. See resha'im's downfall only via EY** (Teh 110:1 "sheiv li'mini...hadom l'raglecha"; Zohar Lech Lecha 86b). Yamin=EY=Binyamin.
intermediate.he: **α. ראיית מפלת רשעים רק דרך א"י** (תה' קי, א; זוה"ק לך לך פו:). ימין=א"י=בנימין.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. תה' קי, א; זוה"ק לך לך פו:.

beginner.en: **"β. Drawing **kedushas EY now in galus** — though she is under **sitra achra** and her kedushah cannot reveal — is possible: **'v'af gam zos b'eretz oyvaihem'** (Vayikra 26:44) — **even in bitter galus, 'gam zos'** can be revealed. Via what? **Hisnotzetzus ohr zechus avos** — Zohar Shelach 174a: **'b'asar d'is tamman avos, is tamman Shechinta.'** **'V'Shechintach tisra'eh ba'hon'** (Zohar ibid.)."**

intermediate.en: **β. Draw kedushas EY now via hisnotzetzus zechus avos** (Vay 26:44 "v'af gam zos"; Zohar Shelach 174a "b'asar avos=Shechinta").
intermediate.he: **β. המשכת קדושת א"י דרך הבזקת זכות אבות** (ויק' כו, מד "ואף גם זאת"; זוה"ק שלח קעד "באתר דאבות=שכינתא").

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. ויק' כו, מד; זוה"ק שלח קעד.

beginner.en: **"γ. Resha'im draw **ra ayin** on their enemies (Berachos 7b **'she'ro'eh b'son'av'**). Saved from it by **l'med zechus** on the rasha. HKBH Himself **learns zechus on rasha** in order to **save the tzaddik from ra ayin of the rasha**. Chazal (ibid.): **'v'lo od ela she'zocheh ba'din'** (**'marom mishpatecha mi'negdo,'** Tehillim 10:5) — the rasha's zechiyah-in-din saves the tzaddik from his ra ayin. To turn the **ra ayin of the rasha into tov ayin** — see a defense for him."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Resha'im draw ra ayin on enemies** (Ber 7b "ro'eh b'son'av"). Saved via **l'med zechus** on rasha (HKBH does same — "zocheh ba'din," Teh 10:5).
intermediate.he: **γ. רשעים מושכים רע עין** (בר' ז: "רואה בשונאיו"). הצלה ע"י **לימוד זכות** על רשע (גם ה' — "זוכה בדין", תה' י, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. בר' ז:; תה' י, ה.

beginner.en: **"δ. Via the tzaddik's strengthened **re'iyah** (seeing **tzidkos Hashem**), his **emunah strengthens** + can **daven**. His lev straightens from its twist — before seeing tzidkos Hashem, it was twisted (doubting if HKBH bends the din). Now seeing — **'v'tzidkascha l'yishrei lev'** (Tehillim 94:15) — lev straightened in **shleimus ha'emunah**. Then strengthens himself + davens for his needs."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Tzaddik's re'iyah (tzidkos Hashem) → emunah strengthens → tefilah**. Lev straightens (Teh 94:15).
intermediate.he: **δ. ראיית הצדיק (צדקות ה') → אמונה מתחזקת → תפילה**. לב נתישר (תה' צד, טו).

beginner.en: **"ε. Bechina of **afar va'eifer** in **parah** (adumah). Tefilah requires this. Subdue the ra, **b'prat + b'klal**, under the tov — **'v'asosem resha'im ki yihyu eifer tachas kapos ragleichem'** (Mal'achi 3:21; Zohar Pekudei 237). **Regel=tefilah** (**'raglai amdah,'** Tehillim 26:12). In prat: nullify **gufo ha'gashmi + his chomer at tefilah-time** — like the **chasidim ha'rishonim** who had **his'pashtus ha'gashmiyus** at tefilah."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Afar va'eifer in tefilah** — subdue ra ("v'asosem resha'im eifer," Mal 3:21; Zohar Pekudei 237). Regel=tefilah (Teh 26:12). Chasidim rishonim=his'pashtus gashmiyus.
intermediate.he: **ε. עפר ואפר בתפילה** — הכנעת רע ("ועסותם רשעים אפר", מל' ג, כא; זוה"ק פקודי רלז). רגל=תפילה (תה' כו, יב). חסידים ראשונים=התפשטות גשמיות.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. מל' ג, כא; תה' כו, יב; זוה"ק פקודי רלז.

beginner.en: **"ζ. Also must rectify in tefilah the **3 kolos**: (1) **'kol k'sil b'rov devarim'** (Kohelet 5:2); (2) **'kol anos anochi shome'a'** (Shemos 32:18); (3) **kol mei'chareif u'megadef** (Tehillim 44:17 'kol mecharef... u'boshes panai kisasni'). These correspond to **eitz erez + eizov + shni tola'as** in parah adumah."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. 3 kolos** (Koh 5:2; Shem 32:18; Teh 44:17) = erez + eizov + shni tola'as of parah adumah.
intermediate.he: **ו. ג' קולות** (קה' ה, ב; שמ' לב, יח; תה' מד, יז) = ארז + אזוב + שני תולעת של פרה אדומה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. קה' ה, ב; שמ' לב, יח; תה' מד, יז.

beginner.en: **"**Erez** = **'kol k'sil b'rov devarim'** = **rov hanhagos + emunos kozvos** = **darkei Emori** (**'peti ya'amin l'chol davar,'** Mishlei 14:15). **Erez** = **'v'anochi hishmad'ti es ha'Emori asher k'govah arazim gov'ho'** (Amos 2:9). High-statured tend to be k'silim — because the ashans rising from lev to mo'ach weaken in the long distance (due to tall stature), so they have fewer thoughts. **Eizov = chizuk ha'lev** to contain chochmah without sinning. **Shni tola'as = cherafos u'bizyonos** from enemies: **'kol ha'yom klimasi negdi u'boshes panai kisasni, mi'kol mecharef u'm'gadef'** (Tehillim 44:16-17); **'v'anochi tola'as v'lo ish, cherpas adam u'b'zuy am'** (Tehillim 22:7)."** **"**Shchitah+sereifah+asifah** of parah = these 3: **shchitah=bitul emunos kozvos** (**'v'shachtah s'tim he'emiku,'** Hoshea 5:2); **sereifah=chizuk ha'lev**; **asifah=transforming bushah to kavod**."**

intermediate.en: **Erez=k'silim-b'rov-devarim=darkei Emori** (Amos 2:9; Mishlei 14:15). **Eizov=chizuk lev**. **Shni tola'as=cherafos** (Teh 44:16-17; 22:7). Parah: shchitah/sereifah/asifah = these 3.
intermediate.he: **ארז=כסילים ברוב דברים=דרכי האמורי** (עמ' ב, ט; מש' יד, טו). **אזוב=חיזוק לב**. **שני תולעת=חרפות** (תה' מד, טז-יז; כב, ז). פרה: שחיטה/שריפה/אסיפה = ג' אלו.

scholarly.he: עמ' ב, ט; מש' יד, טו; תה' מד; כב, ז; הו' ה, ב.

beginner.en: **"Continued breakdown of shni tola'as / tola'as**: **'v'anochi tola'as v'lo ish, cherpas adam u'b'zuy am'** (Tehillim 22:7) — the bizyonos."**

intermediate.en: Shni tola'as=Teh 22:7 "anochi tola'as v'lo ish, cherpas adam."

beginner.en: **"ζ. All this the davener rectifies in tefilah. (1) **Raise those fallen into emunos kozvos** to true emunah. (2) **Rectify hearts of chakrei filosofia** so their lev can contain their sechel w/o failing — **'b'libi tzafanti'** (Tehillim 119:11); done via kavanas ha'lev of tefilah. (3) **Transform all bizyonos/cherafos into kavod** — when standing in **heichal ha'melech** and being m'vatel self entirely, seeing only the **Melech**, then **'v'ha'boshes panai' transforms to 'kavod.'**"**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Davener rectifies: (1) raise fallen-emunos; (2) fix chakrei filosofia lev (Teh 119:11); (3) transform bizyonos→kavod (via heichal ha'melech bitul).
intermediate.he: **ז. מתפלל מתקן: (1) מעלה נפולים־אמונות; (2) מתקן לב חוקרים (תה' קיט, יא); (3) הופך בזיונות→כבוד (בביטול בהיכל המלך).

beginner.en: **"η. Via tefilah **k'tikno** → **ohr zechus avos sparks** (**'chalah zechus avos,'** Zohar Shelach). Accomplished via tefilah — **'va'yichal Moshe'** (Shemos 32:11). **'B'atar d'avos, Shechinta tamman'** = bechina of **challah** (= **'gam zos'** = shiur 43 beitzim) = bechina of **yerushas EY** — mitzvah on entering EY to take challah (**'v'hayah b'achalchem mi'lechem ha'aretz,'** Bamidbar 15:19)."**

intermediate.en: **η. Tefilah k'tikno → zechus avos sparks** (Zohar Shelach "chalah zechus avos"; Shem 32:11 "va'yichal Moshe"). B'atar avos=Shechinta=**challah** (gam zos=43 beitzim)=yerushas EY (Bam 15:19).
intermediate.he: **ז. תפילה כתיקנה → זכות אבות מבצבצת** (זוה"ק שלח "חלה זכות אבות"; שמ' לב, יא). באתר אבות=שכינה=**חלה** (גם זאת=מ"ג ביצים)=ירושת א"י (במ' טו, יט).

scholarly.he: זוה"ק שלח; שמ' לב, יא; במ' טו, יט.

beginner.en: **"**'Kaveh el Hashem u'shmor darko'** (Tehillim 37:34) = **tikkun ha'tefilah = derichas ha'keshes** (bending the bow) = tefilah + **3 gonin d'keshes = ohr avos**. Via this **'vi'romimcha la'reshes aretz'** (EY). Then **'b'hikares resha'im tir'eh'** — bechina of **'sheiv li'mini'** etc. **'Shchan aretz u'r'eh emunah'** (ibid. 3) — via emunah=tefilah → EY."**

intermediate.en: **"Kaveh... u'shmor darko"** (Teh 37:34)=tikkun tefilah=derichas keshes (3 gonin=ohr avos) → "romimcha la'reshes aretz"=EY → "b'hikares resha'im tir'eh." "Shchan aretz u'r'eh emunah" (Teh 37:3).
intermediate.he: **"קווה... ושמור דרכו"** (תה' לז, לד)=תיקון תפילה=דריכת קשת (ג' גוונים=אור אבות) → "רוממך לרשת ארץ"=א"י → "בהיכרת רשעים תראה". "שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה" (תה' לז, ג).

beginner.en: **"θ. Not every person can rectify these kolos. Sometimes they emerge from **resha'im gedolim** — standing against them endangers nefesh. Requires **tefilah gedolah** like Moshe's. Even Moshe feared **Og melech ha'Bashan** — Og's grip was **samuch l'yamin** (EY). HKBH told Moshe **'al tira oso'** (Bamidbar 21:34) — saying **'ha yamina dili istalek'** (Zohar Chukas)."**

intermediate.en: **θ. Not every tzaddik can. Big resha'im → need Moshe-level tefilah. Moshe feared Og (grip near yamin=EY); HKBH "al tira" (Bam 21:34; Zohar Chukas).
intermediate.he: **ח. לא כל צדיק. רשעים גדולים → תפילה כמשה. משה פחד מעוג (אחיזה סמוך לימין=א"י); ה' "אל תירא" (במ' כא, לד; זוה"ק חוקת).

beginner.en: **"**Peirush Abba Shaul**: **'kover meisim hayisi'** — his toil was always **'lir'os b'hikares' resha'im she'b'chayeihem k'ruyim meisim** (Berachos 18b). **'Ratzti achar tzvi'** — ikkar mappalas resha'im via **yerushas EY + drawing kedushas EY**, and **EY=tzvi l'chol ha'aratzos** (Yechezkel 20:6). **'V'nichnasti b'kulis shel meis'** = rectifying **kolos** above. **'Ratzti acharav shalosh parsa'os'** = **3 tefilos** (= 3 bechinos of kolos)."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: kover meisim="ro'eh b'hikares" (Ber 18b "resha'im b'chayeihem k'ruyim meisim"); tzvi=EY (Yech 20:6); kulis=kolos; 3 parsa'os=3 tefilos.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: קובר מתים="ראה בהיכרת" (בר' יח: "רשעים בחייהם קרויים מתים"); צבי=א"י (יחז' כ, ו); קולית=קולות; ג' פרסאות=ג' תפילות.

beginner.en: **"Bechina of **kelalus malach San'del b'malach Metatron sar ha'panim** = kelalus Asiyah in Yetzirah via doubling pasuk **'kol ha'neshamah'** (as in kavanos). **Every breath praises Hashem** (BR 14). Via **ayin ha'ra, nshimah doubles** — when ayin ha'ra hits, one **yawns + opens mouth** to receive double breath. When nshimah doubles, **hallel also doubles** — especially grateful to HKBH for saving from that ra ayin + seeing the rasha's downfall."**

intermediate.en: **Kelalus San'del+Metatron** via doubled "kol ha'neshamah". Every breath praises (BR 14). Ra ayin → double breath → double hallel (for being saved).
intermediate.he: **כללות סנד"ל+מטטרון** ע"י כפל "כל הנשמה". כל נשימה מהללת (ב"ר יד). עין הרע → נשימה כפולה → הלל כפול (על הצלה).
